Welcome to Lotus

A place to eat, relax & enjoy.

Lotus Restaurant offers a warm and comfortable dining environment in Pataudi, with a menu covering popular favourites from pizza and burgers to pasta, garlic bread, fries, shakes and dessert.

Whether you're stopping by for a casual meal or spending time with family and friends, the space is designed for relaxed dining.

Comfortable Dining

A welcoming restaurant setting with comfortable seating.

Variety of Food

Pizza, burgers, pasta, sandwiches, garlic bread, fries, shakes and desserts.

Family Friendly

A comfortable place for casual meals with family and friends.

Easy to Find

Conveniently located on Pataudi Road, Pataudi.
